title: Vacuum evaporation and condensation thermodynamics and evaporation kinetics of pure silver
download_status: Open access article; publisher page exposes View PDF; no separate SI file identified in accessible record
scope_and_limitations: Primary Ag source: vapor-pressure fit, measured rates Tables 5/7, alpha Table 8, kinetics and HKL equations. Vacuum-distillation/Ar furnace conditions, not an electrical-arc calibration.

title: Silver Antoine vapor-pressure correlation
scope_and_limitations: Antoine equation valid 1823-2425 K; pressure output bar; coefficients attributed by NIST to Hartmann & Schneider (1929). Cross-check only.

title: Improved accuracy of continuum surface flux models for metal additive manufacturing melt pool simulations
download_status: Open access direct PDF link; not included in uploaded ZIP
scope_and_limitations: Methodological reference: interface temperature accuracy and temperature-dependent evaporation flux regularization. Their application is macro PBF-LB/M Ti-6Al-4V, not Ag nano-VOF parameter data.

authors_year: Wang, L., Zhang, Y. & Yan, W. (2020)
title: Evaporation Model for Keyhole Dynamics During Additive Manufacturing of Metal
download_status: APS full-text endpoint; not included in uploaded ZIP
scope_and_limitations: Derives mass, momentum and energy flux across Knudsen layer and gas flow; Anisimov 0.54 is a special sonic assumption. Macro keyhole scales and continuum vapor-flow assumptions; not direct nano-scale closure.

title: Evaporation into vacuum: Mass flux from momentum flux and the Hertz-Knudsen relation revisited
download_status: PubMed abstract accessible; full PDF not verified as open
scope_and_limitations: MD study of liquid-film evaporation into vacuum; useful kinetic cross-check, not a parameter source for Ag-Ti3SiC2.

title: Silver thermochemical reference values
scope_and_limitations: Reports a reference vaporization enthalpy about 250.58 kJ/mol; use only as a rough cross-check against derived curve, not primary high-temperature Hvap(T) data.
